### Regulations
Regulatory classification: transparency_obligated  
Article 50, paragraph 1 applies to this feature. It requires the provider to ensure that the chatbot is designed and developed in such a way that natural persons interacting with it are informed that they are interacting with an AI system, unless it is obvious to reasonably well-informed, observant, and circumspect users given the circumstances and context of use. This transparency obligation applies to AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons.  

Under Article 113, the provisions cited here take effect on these dates: 2 August 2026 (Article 50; the general application date).
